newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends weaker after reversal.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends weaker after reversal.

text.p: Despite a larger-than-expected dip in LME stocks Friday and fresh highs notched up during the morning, COMEX copper suffered a midsession reversal to end lower.
LME stocks fell 6,225 tonnes to 208,575 tonnes Friday.
But end-of-week liquidation on LME helped to drag down COMEX.
The market may have reached a stage where Chinese interest will not develop and a downside correction was needed, said William O'Neill of Merrill Lynch.
"Maybe we have seen the top for a while and have to ease back and wait for some physical interest," O'Neill said.
May COMEX settled 0.80 cent lower at 111.40 cents a lb, traded 114.50 to 110.70 cents. Spot March went out 0.40 cent weaker at 115.30 cents a lb.
Volume was estimated at 13,000 lots compared to Thursday's 9,411 lots.
The reversal and weak close was reflected in a slightly lower LME backwardation, down about $10 to $80/85.
Friday, COMEX stocks rose 177 short tons to 25,271 short tons.
